Her throat felt like it was on fire but still she sobbed, uncontrollably, wringing her\"}","{\"text\": \"last tapestry in her hands. One of her women came up the narrow stairs to see her mistress, but her chief guard Zuuk stood\"}","{\"text\": \"at the doorway and shook his head. \\\"She's just heard that her son is dead,\\\" he said quietly.\"}"]}
